decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring twelve (12) months from the date of this permission or one (1) month after the occupation of any approved replacement clubhouse (permanent), whichever is the sooner, after which the use shall cease and the building shall be completely removed from the site and the land returned to its former condition, unless further permission is agreed to in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted for a health and racquets club shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday to Sunday 6:00am to 11:00pm, except for a maximum of five (5) nights per year.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 4 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to all facilities shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description: Retention of a temporary, meeting and catering unit for the Esporta Chiswick Riverside Club
